candidates.source_title: This Book Has a Hidden Secret! 🤯📖 #shorts
candidates.source_description:
This man is holding what looks like an ordinary, antique book, but when he carefully fans the gold-tipped pages, a shocking secret is revealed.

This rare historical technique is a mesmerizing hidden art form known as fore-edge painting.

The incredible, invisible artwork is painted directly onto the edges of the paper, meaning the beautiful, detailed scene only appears when the pages are perfectly bent.
